Licence texts for the licence detection tests (licence_misread_test.go).
All but one are copied unchanged from the SPDX License List
(github.com/spdx/license-list-data, text/, commit 3184648, 2026-10-29).
BSD-3-Clause-difflib-wording.txt is the SPDX BSD-3-Clause text with the
third clause worded as go-difflib words it ("The names of its contributors
may not be used to endorse or promote ...").
